full_text_tesim: Detached components of binding: front leather cover, reinforced with papyrus, to which is attached the spine cover, made of woven fabric with leather and parchment remnants; back leather cover reinforced with papyrus.
Foliation may not correspond to sequence of overtext
Several detached folios are counted here as singletons, because their quire context cannot be determined
Small Arabic numerals in pencil in upper left (followed here); sporadic foliation in pencil in center of bottom margin (not followed)
Small holes aligned horizontally across middle of some folios may be sewing holes, indicating original bifolios with double palimpsest
Unbound quires and detached folios; numerous stubs | Folios curl at gutter; some folios of very stiff parchment
